chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Khafīf, from his father, said:
He sent servants to the city of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), and with them were two servants, and he wrote to Khafīf that he should go out with them, so he went out with them.

Then when they arrived at al-Kūfah, one of the two servants drank an intoxicant, and they had not left al-Kūfah until a letter arrived from al-ʿAskar ordering that the servant who drank the intoxicant be sent back and removed from service.

key_terms.الْعَسْكَرِ: al-ʿAskar, referring to the place from which the letter came
key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: the city of Kūfah where the incident occurred
key_terms.بَعَثَ: he dispatched or sent on a mission
key_terms.خَدَمٍ: servants or attendants sent for service
key_terms.مَدِينَةِ الرَّسُولِ: the city of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, i.e. al-Madīnah

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the dismissal of a servant for drinking an intoxicant during a mission?
ai.summary: This report recounts an incident in which a servant was dismissed after drinking an intoxicant during a mission. It reflects administrative oversight and moral accountability associated with the Imam عليه السلام and preserves a biographical-historical detail connected to his affairs.

en.hubeali: Al Hassan Bin Khafeef, from his father who said,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> sent servants to the city of the Rasool<sup>saww</sup> and with them were two servants, and he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to Khafeef that he goes out with them. So he went out with them,

and when they arrived at Al-Kufa, one of the two servants drank an intoxicant, and they had not gone out from Al-Kufa until there came a letter (from the 12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) from Al-Askar: ‘Return the servant who drank the intoxicant and remove him from the service’.
en.sarwar: 21. Al-Hassan ibn Khafif has narrated from his father who has said the following.

“Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.) had sent certain servants to al-Madina of the Messenger of Allah and among them were two servants. He had written to Khafif to leave with them. He then left with them and they reached al-Kufa

where one of the two servants had consumed alcohol. Before the would al-Kufa a letter came to them from the army camp (city of Surra man Ra’a) that said, “Send back the servant who has consumed alcohol and remove him from the service.”
